9.3 Kuzatilgan ahamiyat darajasi:
p‑qiymatlar
Ta’rif. p‑qiymat — bu 𝐻0
rost deb faraz qilgan holda, kuzatilgan
qiymatga kamida shuncha ekstremal bo‘lgan statistikani (muqobil
yo‘nalishida) olish ehtimoli.
Talqin. Kichik p‑qiymatlar 𝐻0 ga qarshi dalil beradi. Ular 𝐻0
rost
bo‘lish ehtimoli emas.
R yordamchi funksiyalari (bir/ikki tomonlama).
```{r}
# z va t sinovlari uchun p‑qiymat yordamchilari
pval_z <- function(z_obs, alternative = c("two.sided", "less",
"greater")) {
alternative <- match.arg(alternative)
if (alternative == "two.sided")
2 * pnorm(-abs(z_obs)) else if (alternative == "greater")
1 - pnorm(z_obs) else pnorm(z_obs)
}
pval_t <- function(t_obs, df, alternative = c("two.sided", "less",
"greater")) {
alternative <- match.arg(alternative)
if (alternative == "two.sided")
2 * pt(-abs(t_obs), df) else if (alternative == "greater")
1 - pt(t_obs, df) else pt(t_obs, df)
}
pval_z(2.1, "two.sided")
## [1] 0.03572884
pval_t(-1.9, df = 18, alternative = "greater")
## [1] 0.9632128
```
9.4 Bosh o‘rtacha haqidagi gipoteza:
normal (𝑧) statistikasi
Qachon ishlatiladi. Bosh SKO 𝜎 ma’lum; bosh to‘plam normal yoki
𝑛 ≳ 30.
Gipotezalar. 𝐻0
∶ 𝜇 = 𝜇0 va mos 𝐻1
.
Statistika.
𝑍 = 𝑋 − 𝜇 ̄
0
𝜎/√
𝑛
∼ 𝑁(0, 1) (𝐻0
ostida).
R (qo‘lda 𝑧‑sinov, paketlarsiz).
```{r}
z_test_mean <- function(x, mu0, sigma, alternative = c("two.sided",
"less", "greater")) {
alternative <- match.arg(alternative)
n <- length(x)
xbar <- mean(x)
z <- (xbar - mu0)/(sigma/sqrt(n))
p <- pval_z(z, alternative)
c(statistic = z, p_value = p, mean = xbar, n = n)
}
x <- rnorm(40, mean = 101, sd = 15) # misol ma'lumotlar
z_test_mean(x, mu0 = 100, sigma = 15, alternative = "two.sided")
## statistic p_value mean n
## 0.5481223 0.5836079 101.2999863 40.0000000
```
9.5 Bosh o‘rtacha haqidagi gipoteza:
Studentning 𝑡‑statistikasi
Qachon ishlatiladi. 𝜎 noma’lum. Bosh to‘plam normal yoki 𝑛 yetarlicha
katta.
Statistika.
𝑇 = 𝑋 − 𝜇 ̄
0
𝑆/√
𝑛
∼ 𝑡𝜈
, 𝜈 = 𝑛 − 1 (𝐻0
).
R (bir tanlamali 𝑡‑sinov).
```{r}
y <- rnorm(22, mean = 50, sd = 8)
# Ikki tomonlama sinov H0: mu=50
res2 <- t.test(y, mu = 50)
# O'ng‑dumli sinov H0: mu<=50 ga qarshi H1: mu>50
resR <- t.test(y, mu = 50, alternative = "greater")
list(two_sided = res2$p.value, right_tailed = resR$p.value, confint = res2$conf.int)
## $two_sided
## [1] 0.2343165
##
## $right_tailed
## [1] 0.8828417
##
## $confint
## [1] 45.37143 51.19785
## attr(,"conf.level")
## [1] 0.95

```
9.6 Katta tanlama uchun bosh ulush
haqidagi gipoteza
Qachon ishlatiladi. Katta hisoblar: 𝑛 ̂𝑝 ≥ 10 va 𝑛(1 − ̂𝑝) ≥ 10.
Nol gipoteza. 𝐻0
∶ 𝑝 = 𝑝0
.
Vald 𝑧 statistikasi.
𝑍 = ̂𝑝 − 𝑝0
√𝑝0
(1 − 𝑝0
)/𝑛
.
R (qo‘lda va prop.test orqali).
```{r}
prop_z_test <- function(x, n, p0, alternative = c("two.sided",
"less", "greater")) {
alternative <- match.arg(alternative)
phat <- x/n
z <- (phat - p0)/sqrt(p0 * (1 - p0)/n)
p <- pval_z(z, alternative)
c(statistic = z, p_value = p, phat = phat, n = n)
}
x <- 62
n <- 120
p0 <- 0.5
manual <- prop_z_test(x, n, p0, alternative = "two.sided")
score <- prop.test(x, n, p = p0, alternative = "two.sided") # skor (Wilson) sinovi
list(manual = manual, prop_test_p = score$p.value)
## $manual
## statistic p_value phat n
## 0.3651484 0.7150007 0.5166667 120.0000000
##
## $prop_test_p
## [1] 0.7841912

```
9.7 II tur xatolik ehtimollari va quvvatni
hisoblash
Misol tariqasida ma’lum 𝜎 bilan o‘rtacha uchun 𝑧‑sinovni olamiz (rejalashtirish bosqichi). 𝐻0
∶ 𝜇 = 𝜇0
, haqiqiy qiymat 𝜇1 bo‘lsin.
Ikki tomonlama sinov (𝛼 daraja). |𝑍| > 𝑧𝛼/2 bo‘lsa rad etamiz.
𝜇 = 𝜇1
ostida
𝑍 ∼ 𝑁(𝜇1 − 𝜇0
𝜎/√
𝑛
, 1) .
Quvvat = 1 − 𝛽(𝜇1
):
1 − 𝛽 = Pr (|𝑍| > 𝑧𝛼/2 ∣ 𝜇 = 𝜇1
) = 1 − Φ(𝑧𝛼/2 − Δ) + Φ(−𝑧𝛼/2 − Δ) ,
bu yerda Δ = (𝜇1 − 𝜇0
)/(𝜎/√
𝑛), Φ — standart normal KD (CDF).
R (quvvat egrilari va maqsad quvvat uchun 𝑛).
```{r}
power_z_mean <- function(n, sigma, mu0, mu1, alpha = 0.05, two.sided = TRUE) {
zcrit <- if (two.sided)
qnorm(1 - alpha/2) else qnorm(1 - alpha)
delta <- (mu1 - mu0)/(sigma/sqrt(n))
if (two.sided) {
1 - (pnorm(zcrit - delta) - pnorm(-zcrit - delta))
} else {
# odatda o'ng‑dumli; chap‑dumli uchun (mu1-mu0)
# ishorasini almashtiring
1 - pnorm(zcrit - delta)
}
}
n_for_power_z <- function(target_power, sigma, mu0, mu1, alpha = 0.05,
two.sided = TRUE) {
uniroot(function(n) power_z_mean(n, sigma, mu0, mu1, alpha,
two.sided) - target_power, c(2, 1e+06))$root |>
ceiling()
}
sigma <- 10
mu0 <- 100
mu1 <- 103
alpha <- 0.05
n_needed <- n_for_power_z(0.8, sigma, mu0, mu1, alpha, two.sided = TRUE)
# tezkor quvvat egri chizig'i (n bo'yicha)
ns <- seq(10, 400, by = 10)
pows <- sapply(ns, power_z_mean, sigma = sigma, mu0 = mu0, mu1 = mu1,
alpha = alpha, two.sided = TRUE)
head(data.frame(n = ns, power = pows))
## n power
## 1 10 0.1577560
## 2 20 0.2686618
## 3 30 0.3758563
## 4 40 0.4751009
## 5 50 0.5641160
## 6 60 0.6420152
```

R (p‑qiymatni qo‘lda).
```{r}
chi2_test_var <- function(x, sigma0_sq, alternative = c("two.sided",
"less", "greater")) {
alternative <- match.arg(alternative)
n <- length(x)
s2 <- var(x)
df <- n - 1
chi2 <- df * s2/sigma0_sq
if (alternative == "two.sided") {
p <- 2 * min(pchisq(chi2, df), 1 - pchisq(chi2, df))
} else if (alternative == "greater") {
p <- 1 - pchisq(chi2, df)
} else {
p <- pchisq(chi2, df)
}
c(statistic = chi2, df = df, s2 = s2, p_value = p)
}
z <- rnorm(18, mean = 0, sd = 4)
chi2_test_var(z, sigma0_sq = 16, alternative = "two.sided")
## statistic df s2 p_value
## 17.3975643 17.0000000 16.3741782 0.8555224
```
9.9 Ishlangan misollar
Misol A (ikki tomonlama 𝑡‑sinov)
15 ta cho‘zilish mustahkamligi (MPa) o‘lchovi: ̄𝑥 = 47.3, 𝑠 = 5.2.
𝐻0
∶ 𝜇 = 50 ni 𝛼 = 0.05 da tekshiring.
```{r}
n <- 15
xbar <- 47.3
s <- 5.2
mu0 <- 50
T <- (xbar - mu0)/(s/sqrt(n))
df <- n - 1
p <- 2 * pt(-abs(T), df)
c(statistic = T, df = df, p_value = p)
## statistic df p_value
## -2.01097212 14.00000000 0.06399397
```
